blocks.title: Grammar Hook: Reported Speech
blocks.body: Did you know that Reported Speech errors are among the top 5 mistakes in board exams? Master this today and secure your marks!
blocks.body_hi: क्या आप जानते हैं कि अप्रत्यक्ष कथन की गलतियां बोर्ड परीक्षा में शीर्ष 5 गलतियों में से एक हैं? आज इसे समझें!
blocks.body_gu: Reported Speech errors = top board exam mistakes. Fix them today!

blocks.question: Before we study Reported Speech, can you try to identify the error in this sentence: 'She go to school every day'?
blocks.question_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन सीखने से पहले, क्या आप इस वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचान सकते हैं?
blocks.explanation: Think about it! This is exactly what Reported Speech helps us fix. Let us discover the rules together.
blocks.explanation_hi: यही अप्रत्यक्ष कथन सही करने में मदद करता है।

blocks.title: Discover: Reported Speech in Real Life
blocks.title_hi: खोज: वास्तविक जीवन में अप्रत्यक्ष कथन
blocks.body: Look around you — Reported Speech appears in every English text you read, every exam you write, every email you send. Mastering Reported Speech = mastering English communication.
blocks.body_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन हर अंग्रेजी पाठ में, हर परीक्षा में, हर ईमेल में दिखाई देता है। अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में महारत = अंग्रेजी संचार में महारत।
blocks.body_gu: Reported Speech — everywhere in English. Master it = master English.

blocks.title: The Rules of Reported Speech
blocks.body:
Direct Speech quotes exact words: He said, 'I am happy.'
Indirect Speech reports meaning: He said (that) he was happy.

Key Changes in Indirect Speech:
1. Inverted commas removed.
2. 'That' added.
3. Tense changes back (backshift): am→was, is→was, are→were, will→would, can→could, has→had, have→had
4. Pronouns change: I→he/she, we→they, you→he/she/they
5. Time expressions change: now→then, today→that day, yesterday→the day before, tomorrow→the next day, here→there
blocks.body_hi:
प्रत्यक्ष भाषण सटीक शब्दों को उद्धृत करता है: उसने कहा, 'मैं खुश हूं।'
अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण अर्थ रिपोर्ट करता है: उसने कहा कि वह खुश था।

मुख्य परिवर्तन: काल पीछे जाता है, सर्वनाम बदलते हैं, समय अभिव्यक्तियां बदलती हैं।
blocks.body_gu:
Direct Speech = exact words. Indirect = report.
Tense backshift: am/is→was. Pronoun: I→he/she.

blocks.title: Board Exam Tip: Reported Speech
blocks.body: In CBSE Class 9 board exam, Reported Speech questions appear in: (1) Fill in the blanks (2) Editing/Omission exercises (3) Rearranging jumbled sentences (4) Sentence transformation. Always justify your answer with the rule!
blocks.body_hi: CBSE Class 9 बोर्ड परीक्षा में अप्रत्यक्ष कथन प्रश्न आते हैं: (1) रिक्त स्थान भरना (2) संपादन/लोपन (3) अव्यवस्थित वाक्य (4) वाक्य परिवर्तन।
blocks.body_gu: Board exam — Reported Speech appears in: Fill blanks, Editing, Jumbled sentences, Transformation.

blocks.title: Solved Example 1: Reported Speech
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 1: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन
blocks.problem: He said, 'I am very tired.' → Indirect?
blocks.solution: He said (that) he was very tired. Changes: 'I'→'he', 'am'→'was', inverted commas removed.
blocks.solution_hi: He said that he was very tired. 'I'→'he', 'am'→'was'.

blocks.title: Solved Example 2: Reported Speech
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 2: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन
blocks.problem: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.' → Indirect?
blocks.solution: She said that she would come the next day. Changes: will→would, tomorrow→the next day, I→she.

blocks.title: Solved Example 3: Reported Speech
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 3: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन
blocks.problem: He said, 'Can you help me?' → Indirect?
blocks.solution: He asked if I could help him. [Questions: use 'asked if/whether', change 'can'→'could', 'you'→'I', 'me'→'him']
blocks.solution_hi: asked if I could help him.

blocks.question: 'She said, I love reading books.' Change to Indirect Speech.
blocks.question_hi: Indirect में बदलें: 'She said, I love reading books.'
blocks.question_gu: Indirect: 'She said, I love reading books.'
options: She said she loved reading books.
She said she loves reading books.
She said that I love books.
She told she loved books.
options_hi: She said she loved reading books.
She said she loves reading books.
She said that I love books.
blocks.explanation: Indirect: She said (that) she LOVED reading books. Changes: 'I'→'she', 'love'→'loved' (tense backshift: present→past).
blocks.explanation_hi: she said that she LOVED. I→she, love→loved.

blocks.question: He said, 'I was watching TV yesterday.' → Indirect Speech.
blocks.question_hi: Indirect: 'He said, I was watching TV yesterday.'
options: He said he had been watching TV the day before.
He said he was watching TV yesterday.
He said he has been watching TV.
He told he was watching TV.
blocks.explanation: Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous: 'was watching'→'had been watching'. 'yesterday'→'the day before'.
blocks.explanation_hi: Past Continuous → Past Perfect Continuous. yesterday → the day before.
blocks.explanation_gu: was watching → had been watching. yesterday → day before.

blocks.question: The teacher said, 'Do not make noise.' → Indirect?
options: Teacher said to not make noise.
Teacher told not making noise.
Teacher ordered them not to make noise.
Teacher told them make no noise.
blocks.explanation: Commands use 'ordered/told/asked + object + (not) to V1'. Negative command: 'not to make'. → 'The teacher ordered them NOT TO MAKE noise.'
blocks.explanation_hi: Commands: ordered/told + object + not to V1.

blocks.question: Fill blank: 'She asked me _____ I was feeling better.'
blocks.question_hi: रिक्त भरें: 'She asked me _____ I was feeling better.'
blocks.question_gu: 'She asked me _____ I was feeling better.'
options: that
if
what
which
blocks.explanation: Use 'if/whether' when reporting Yes/No questions. 'Are you feeling better?' → 'She asked me IF I was feeling better.'

blocks.question: Board Edit: 'He told me that he will come tomorrow.' Find error.
blocks.question_hi: Board Edit: 'He told me that he will come tomorrow.'
options: told → said
will → would; tomorrow → the next day
come → comes
No error
blocks.explanation: Two errors: (1) 'will'→'would' (tense backshift). (2) 'tomorrow'→'the next day' (time expression change). Correct: 'He told me that he WOULD come THE NEXT DAY.'

blocks.title: Reflect & Apply
blocks.body: Write 5 sentences of your own using Reported Speech. Try to use as many rules as you have learnt today. Then, check if you have used the rules correctly.
blocks.body_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन का उपयोग करके अपने 5 वाक्य लिखें।
blocks.body_gu: Reported Speech use karke 5 sentences lakho.

blocks.title: Connection: Grammar in Writing
blocks.body: Reported Speech connects to: Letter Writing (use correct tenses), Story Writing (maintain consistent tense), Comprehension passages (identify tenses used by the author), and all future English chapters.
blocks.body_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन जुड़ा है: पत्र लेखन, कहानी लेखन, बोधगम्य अनुच्छेदों से।
blocks.body_gu: Reported Speech connects to: Letter writing, Story writing, Comprehension passages.

blocks.title: Mastery: Reported Speech — Board Ready!
blocks.title_hi: महारत: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन — बोर्ड के लिए तैयार!
blocks.body: Excellent! You have completed Reported Speech for Class 9. You can now confidently handle ALL board exam questions on Reported Speech. Remember: Practice is the key to perfection!
blocks.body_hi: शानदार! आपने Class 9 के लिए अप्रत्यक्ष कथन पूरा किया। अब आप बोर्ड परीक्षा के सभी प्रश्न आत्मविश्वास से हल कर सकते हैं!
blocks.body_gu: Class 9 Reported Speech COMPLETE! Board exam ready!
